skills.name: metboi-agentic
skills.description: Use when the user wants an AI agent to work on Meteora from a limited vault wallet. Covers budgets and balances, quotes, swaps, and limit orders; DLMM and DAMM v2 liquidity, including choosing or moving a bin range, adding, removing, rebalancing, and claiming fees and rewards; creating pools; and launching tokens on DBC with fee claims. Runs through the metboi CLI. The vault enforces the limits on-chain.
